description.narrative: Malawi, Zambia. Pride Community Health Organization {PriCHO} and Life Concern Organization {LICO} propose to implement through an exchange programme, a three (3) year project whose objectives will be to integrate, strengthen, and improve the organizational capacities of both partners, and empower young people with entrepreneurship knowledge and skills, and provide quality adolescent gender responsive SRH services at community level. This action of investing in institutional capacity, facilitating and supporting sustainable means of economic empowerment and at the same time providing quality gender responsive sexual and reproductive health services will contribute to the wellbeing of young people especially girls and young mothers. In recent years, research has proved that women influence over financial decisions has the potential to improve sexual and reproductive health behaviours including sustained use of modern contraceptive methods and ultimately lead to increased economic growth and healthy communities.
